# PAUSE Studio

> PAUSE Studio is a small web design and AI video ad studio. The founder personally designs and builds every custom website, and makes AI video ads from a business's existing photos. Clients pay once for the build, with a $0 basic monthly fee (maintenance and hosting included). Based in Auckland, New Zealand, and working remotely with businesses in the United States, New Zealand, South Korea and beyond. Works in English and Korean.

## Website pricing (pay once, $0 basic monthly fee)

Prices show the same numbers in USD for US clients and NZD for New Zealand clients. Clients elsewhere, including South Korea, get a quote in the currency of where their business is located.

- STARTER, 1,990: custom brand site that introduces services and takes inquiries.
- BUSINESS, from 4,490: products, inventory, bookings, orders and online payments.
- ENTERPRISE, custom quote: AI workflow automation, ERP/POS/CRM connections, advanced SEO.
- Included on every plan: free maintenance, no monthly management fee, free hosting within normal traffic, basic SEO (metadata, sitemap, structured data), 2 rounds of design revisions, a site the owner can edit.
- Not included: domain registration and renewal, card processing fees, paid third-party services, new features after launch.
- Typical timeline: 2 to 6 weeks. The domain is registered in the client's name wherever possible.

## AI video ad pricing

- AI SHORT AD, 490
- AI BRAND AD, 890
- AI HERO FILM, from 1,490
- MONTHLY CREATIVE, 2,490 per month: four AI video ads a month for one brand (optional).
- Every plan includes landscape (16:9) and vertical (9:16) Full HD MP4 files, so videos work on websites, YouTube, Reels and Shorts.

## How a project works

1. Free 1:1 consultation to understand the business.
2. Scope and quote confirmed, build fee paid upfront.
3. Custom design and development from scratch, no templates.
4. Review and two rounds of revisions.
5. Launch and handover of admin tools. No monthly fee to PAUSE Studio after that.
